subject: Request for information prior to booking for Humanoids Summit
text:
Hi [NAME],

I'm writing from an Encord, a data infrastructure platform used by robotics
and embodied AI teams to optimise their multimodal pipelines. This event
looks extremely interesting, especially the speaker line-up, and we're
preparing a business use case before booking our tickets.

What I'm trying to validate in doing so, is the broader attendee quality
beyond the speakers:

   1. What's the typical seniority and role breakdown of paid attendees,
   e.g. roughly what % are researchers/engineers vs. executives/founders?
   2. What types of organisations tend to send people: deep tech startups,
   enterprise R&D, university labs?
   3. What's the geographic split: roughly how many attendees are coming
   from outside Japan?
   4. Do you have a post-event summary or attendee breakdown from the
   Silicon Valley [YEAR] edition you could share?
   5. On the VIP Reception, how does access work, and are you able to share
   which company types attended at the previous event?

Happy to jump on a quick call if easier. We're looking to propose this
decision ASAP.

subject: Looking for Annotation Delivery Partners
text:
Hi,

We're evaluating new partners for a variety of projects. If successful from
POC, the partner will have the opportunity to work on projects requiring
50+ full time annotators in production.

Our Expectations for the ideal partner:

   - Project manager required on your end, responsible for project setup
   and quality guarantee
   - We will provide annotation tools and instructions

Project types of interest:

   - Video Descriptions (C2 English level, typical household chores, no
   special industry or knowledge required)
   - Transcription in English, French, German, Portuguese, Spanish,
   preferably 3+ from this combination )
   - 3D Point Cloud annotation
   - Image/Video Object Detection vs Semantic Segmentation
   - Medical imaging annotation (Surgeon, Dentist, Behavioural Health
   Evaluation)

If you have experience and can support on the above, we would like to
schedule a 30 min intro call to learn about your offerings

subject: Edge case discovery for fake ID detection | Working w/ Onfido & Veriff
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw the senior CV hire focused on document analysis and anomaly detection
at 100M IDs/year scale. We work with identity and document verification
teams like Onfido and Veriff, so the timing felt worth a note.

Their ML leads came to us when:

   1. False positive rates plateaued because edge cases (altered IDs, novel
   forgeries) were buried in millions of normal scans
   2. Document ontologies across states and regions broke their existing
   annotation tooling
   3. Near real-time HITL workflows left no room for model regressions in
   production

Worth 15 mins to compare notes? Thursdays 11:00-13:00 and Fridays
09:00-12:00 usually work well for me.

subject: UAV false detections with CVAT| Working w/ Skydio, Zipline, Forterra
text:
Hi [NAME],

New AI leaders at autonomous drone companies usually inherit the same
pipeline issues. Three we see most often with teams running CVAT + ClearML
at [COMPANY]' scale:

   1. QA bottlenecks on multimodal (RGB + thermal) data
   2. Thermal false positives slipping through to production
   3. Training cycles stretching as curation lags behind ingestion

Teams we work with like Zipline, Skydio, and Forterra hit similar walls
before moving off CVAT.

Worth 15 min to compare notes? Wednesdays from 15:00-16:00 and Thursdays
from 12:00-14:00 usually work for me.

subject: Edge case discovery on flight data | Working w/ Skydio, Zipline & Forterra
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw the Sr CV hire for multi-camera visual target tracking. We work with
autonomous flight teams like Skydio, Zipline, and Forterra, so this caught
my eye.

Their algorithms engineers came to us when:

   1. Annotating multimodal data (camera + LiDAR + thermal) accurately at
   speed was a bottleneck
   2. Flight data was hard to mine for the failure modes hurting tracker
   robustness
   3. Re-ID labeling across camera views broke their existing tooling

Worth a quick chat on how Teledyne is tackling these? Thursdays 12:00-15:00
and Fridays 10:00-14:00 usually work well for me.
